title: Update publication from an earlier delivery
note: docs/adr/1320. Each case publishes the book into $first, applies its edits, asks file.publish.status of $first and publishes an update with previous=$first into $second. Stale sheets, page sources, object digests and carried sheets are computed here from boxes and JSON, never read from KentOS. $uidOf:N is slot N's persistent id; $new an object the case creates.

cases.name: nothing changed: every page carried
an east parcel moved: only the pages showing it are made again
a west parcel moved: its three pages made again under an unchanged revision
a middle parcel seen at 1:500 east, 1:1000 and 1:5000
a parcel half in the west frame
a parcel moved out of every frame is removed from its pages
a parcel moved from west to east is removed there and added here
an attribute alone changes no page: its object is listed, the pages carried
a deleted east parcel is removed from its pages
a new east parcel is added to its pages
a layer colour changes every page and names the layers
an advanced revision makes its sheet again with no note
a moved parcel with one revision advanced
a delivered file altered on disk is made again, the rest carried
a delivered file removed is made again
a renamed pattern carries the same bytes under new names
an update of two sheets in a chosen order
another resolution carries nothing
a delivery without geo-reference carries nothing into a geo-referenced one
the plan of an update says what it carries and writes nothing
an update is not a single PDF
an update is not resumable
the earlier delivery is an absolute folder
a folder without a publication is not an earlier delivery
an update never overwrites the earlier delivery
